`pattern_fit`: A+B — the fix spans 7 entry points across importer, upload middleware, media-inliner second implementation, oembed and a boot-level libvips block, plus an untouched public image-derivative route (`handle-image-sizes.js:106-142`).

Strongest lever: the media-inliner service as an out-of-scope second implementation (`external-media-inliner.js:185-206`) — buffer-based, in another service directory, and easy to argue the import advisory does not cover it.

Biggest red flag: none of the defined flags hold; the residual risks are unmeasured repo size, and that the oembed/inliner paths need outbound-HTTP stubbing (recorded in `unverified`).
